Exercise: Kneeling Single-Arm High Pulley Row

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- unilateral_row

Primary Muscles:

- lats

Secondary Muscles:

- biceps
- middle back

Equipment:

- cable

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
moderate

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:
None

Contraindications:

- condition: shoulder instability, reason: due to the overhead position of the arm
- condition: lower back issues, reason: kneeling position may exacerbate symptoms

Exercise Variations:

- variation_name: Kneeling Single-Arm Cable Row with Bent Knee, mechanic: compound, primaryMuscles: ['lats'], secondaryMuscles: ['biceps', 'middle back']

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row, equipment: dumbbells

Instructions:

- Attach a single handle to a high pulley and make your weight selection.
- Kneel in front of the cable tower, taking the cable with one hand with your arm extended. This will be your starting position.
- Starting with your palm facing forward, pull the weight down to your torso by flexing the elbow and retract the shoulder blade. As you do so, rotate the wrist so that at the completion of the movement, your palm is now facing you.
- After a brief pause, return to the starting position.
